Footnote Extraction Test

This document contains an in-body footnote reference1 and a corresponding footnote entry near the bottom of the page. The first attempt at this fixture prefixed each footnote entry with a literal "1."/"2." — docling's layout model read that as an ordered list rather than a footnote, the same failure mode as the list-marker text in the lists fixture. This revision drops the manual numbering and instead adds enough real body text that the footnote block naturally lands near the bottom of a full page, closer to how a real footnote is actually positioned in a real document.
